icp_note: Reputed private K-12 schools with sizeable Class 11-12 cohorts, visible extracurricular/innovation culture, and active parent communities. Board matters less than prestige and openness to external programming.

dimensions.label: Brand alignment
dimensions.guidance: Schools that market themselves on holistic education, innovation labs, arts, clubs or beyond-academics programming score HIGH; purely exam-factory positioning scores low.

dimensions.label: Senior cohort
dimensions.guidance: Larger Class 11-12 strength = more students reached per workshop = higher score.

dimensions.label: Event openness
dimensions.guidance: Evidence of hosting external events, fests, guest talks, MUNs, career fairs = higher.

dimensions.label: DM access
dimensions.guidance: Named principal/correspondent/activities-coordinator with reachable contact info = higher.
